description.value: Twin Sails Brewing opened in 2015 on Port Moody's 'Brewers Row', founded by identical twin brothers whose name also nods to the sailboats visible on Burrard Inlet right out front. The brewery specialises in progressive American IPAs, stouts, sours, and wild barrel ales, with a taproom, patio, arcade, and a weekend food truck (Mama Said's Pizza) on site. Dogs are welcome on the patio and guests may bring outside food, making it a convivial stop for cyclists riding the Burrard Inlet corridor.
